subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should `OpenClawPluginToolContext.runId` become the supported public contract for plugin-owned per-run resource ownership, or must browser ownership remain behind a narrower internal/browser-specific seam?
rationale: The field is mechanically additive, documented, and tested, but once published it becomes an external Plugin SDK compatibility commitment that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve opaque run ownership
options.body: Accept the optional documented `runId` contract and finish review after real browser-path proof confirms the ordering and ownership behavior.

options.title: Narrow the ownership seam
options.body: Keep run ownership internal or browser-specific and revise the patch so unrelated plugins do not receive a new public lifecycle identifier.

options.title: Pause the lifecycle redesign
options.body: Leave the existing sequential cleanup behavior in place if the public contract and additional gate complexity are not worth the completion-latency improvement.

recommendation.title: Approve opaque run ownership
recommendation.body: Accept the optional documented `runId` contract and finish review after real browser-path proof confirms the ordering and ownership behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the central subagent lifecycle makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the API-boundary and ordering decision.
